title: The Spanish R Is Not A Crisis
voice_notes: Warm, patient teacher. One voice. Brian v3. English prompts use language_code en; Spanish reveals use language_code es. Avoid Language Transfer branding.

segments.say: The Spanish are sound scares people more than it should.
segments.display: The Spanish R scares people more than it should.
segments.show:
the Spanish R
is not a crisis

segments.say: At the start of a word, this sound gets the stronger flick.
Try the English word regular, with Spanish sound.
And real, with that same first sound.
Inside a word, a single are sound is lighter.
segments.display: Inside a word, a single R is lighter.

segments.say: But double are gets the stronger sound again.
segments.display: But double R gets the stronger sound again.

segments.say: If the strong sound does not come out yet, do not let it stop you.
segments.show:
do not let it
stop you

segments.say: Keep listening. Keep the mouth relaxed. The sound can arrive later.

caption: Initial r and double rr use the stronger Spanish R: regular, real, perro. A single r inside a word is lighter: pero.
